source.detail: Germanium thermal conductivity at 300 K from a kALDo direct-inversion BTE run with the Mahdizadeh and Akhlamadi (2017) Tersoff parameters for Ge, finite-difference second-order (4x4x4 supercell) and third-order (3x3x3 supercell) force constants and an 8x8x8 q-point mesh (the absolute value is far below the measured 60.2 W/(m K), and which choice sets it, the parameter set, the mesh or the broadening, is not established).
